The '''Myrkr SS-23''' was a model of ''Sewage Spreader'' [[Agrirobot/Legends|agribot]] produced on the planet [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]]. Droid-like in its aspect, simple in its function, its large tank rode upon wheels.

The crude-looking machine, into which foul matter was poured, featured a jet nozzle that could spread muck, slop and fodder in a wide arc. It also had a "narrow jet" setting and an "ejection speed" that ranged from low to maximum (at which point it became nothing less than a sewer "cannon").

At least one such [[Agrirobot|agricultural]] [[Service droid/Legends|service droid]] was owned by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]], which she employed in the creation and maintenance of her luxurious if notorious [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] within her [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|palace]] near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], one week before the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], while fleeing from a sinister band of escaped-[[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trackers near one of the garden's walled thickets, used the Myrkr SS-23 as a weapon against the [[Professional Podracing Circuit|professional]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]]-turned-criminal, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]], to quickly and most efficiently mask his own identity—a 'cover up' that clearly went beyond the simple [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] cloak that Anakin wore. To accomplish this, the boy slave, manning the Myrkr SS-23, gave Sebulba a shower to his face and body, the like of which the Dug may never have before experienced. Without a doubt, the jettisoned spray served as the perfect 'cloak', and the boy was never recognized.
